solve_case:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Converts 1-based edge pairs to 0-based, assigns positive/negative arrival times to components, processes a sorted negative-time queue to fill missing receipt times, then derives each edge's latency from sorted receipt order and returns them as a space-separated string." solve_case]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> in_times </REF>: list of int "Per-component input times; positive values are absolute times, negative values become pending receipt events by their absolute value."
        <REF> edges </REF>: list of (int, int) tuples "Original 1-based node pairs representing edges whose latencies will be computed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str "Space-separated latency values for all edges, using the sentinel 1000000 where no latency was set."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize latencies to a list containing 1000000 repeated once per edge in the original edges list, before edges is rebound. RESULT latencies]
            [COMMAND Rebind edges by reading the original edges list and creating a new list of (a-1, b-1) tuples for every (a, b) in the original edges, converting node IDs from 1-based to 0-based. RESULT edges]
            [COMMAND Initialize abs_times to a list containing 1000000 repeated once per element in in_times. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND For each index and value i in in_times, if i is strictly positive, set abs_times[index] = i; zero and negative values leave abs_times unchanged. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND Initialize pos_times to an empty list. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND For each index and value i in in_times, if i is strictly negative, append (abs(i), index) to pos_times; zero and positive values are ignored. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND Sort pos_times in ascending order by its first element, with the stable sort preserving tuple order for equal first elements. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND Initialize current_time = 0 and received = 1. RESULT current_time, received]
            [COMMAND While pos_times is non-empty: if the first remaining tuple's first element equals received, increment current_time by 1, set new_received = 0, then while pos_times is non-empty and the first tuple's first element equals received, increment new_received, set abs_times[index] = current_time for that tuple's stored index, and remove that tuple from the front of pos_times; after consuming the batch, increase received by new_received. Otherwise, when the first remaining tuple's first element is not received, collect all values in abs_times strictly greater than current_time into next_times; if next_times is non-empty, set current_time to min(next_times), set received_count = 0, count all values in abs_times less than or equal to current_time into received_count, and leave received unchanged because received_count is not assigned back to received. RESULT abs_times, pos_times, current_time, received]
            [COMMAND Prepend 0 to abs_times by assigning abs_times = [0] + abs_times. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND Build sorted_receipt as a list of (value, index) pairs from enumerate(abs_times), then sort sorted_receipt in ascending order by value, using index as the tie-breaker. RESULT sorted_receipt]
            [COMMAND For each (time, comp) in sorted_receipt excluding the first tuple, scan edges in order with their edge indices. First, if comp equals endpoint A and abs_times[A] > abs_times[B], set latencies[index] = abs_times[A] - abs_times[B] and break out of the edge scan for this comp. Then, unless that break occurred, if comp equals endpoint B and abs_times[B] > abs_times[A], set latencies[index] = abs_times[B] - abs_times[A] and break. If no condition matches, continue scanning the next edge. The time value from the sorted triplet is unused. RESULT latencies]
            [COMMAND Join the string form of every value in latencies with a single space, yielding an empty string if latencies is empty, and return that string. RESULT returned_string]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: During the outer while loop's else branch, next_times is empty because no value in abs_times is strictly greater than current_time.]
        [LOG "ValueError: min() arg is an empty sequence"]
        [THROW ValueError "min(next_times) is called with an empty list."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
